info.title: NSchema.Cli
info.description: A declarative database schema migration tool built for .NET

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: A declarative database schema migration tool.

options.name: --help
options.description: Show help and usage information

options.name: --version
options.description: Show version information

options.name: --no-color
options.description: Disable colored output. Also honored via the NO_COLOR environment variable. [default: False]

commands.name: init
commands.description: Scaffold an nschema.json config and a sample schema in the current directory.

options.name: --format
options.description: Format for the generated config and sample schema: yaml (default) or json.

options.name: --force
options.description: Overwrite an existing nschema.json. [default: False]

commands.name: plan
commands.description: Compute and show the migration plan without applying it.

options.name: --config
options.description: Path to the NSchema config file. Defaults to ./nschema.json if present.

options.name: --provider
options.description: Database provider supplying the live schema (e.g. postgres).

options.name: --connection-string
options.description: Connection string for the database provider.

options.name: --state-file
options.description: Path for a file state store.

options.name: --state-s3-bucket
options.description: Bucket for an S3 state store.

options.name: --state-s3-key
options.description: Object key for an S3 state store.

options.name: --format
options.description: The format the desired schema is expressed in: yaml (default) or json.

options.name: --schema-dir
options.description: Directory containing the desired-schema files. Required for plan and apply unless set in config.

options.name: --schema-pattern
options.description: Glob matched within the schema directory. Defaults to a per-format pattern (e.g. **/*.yaml).

options.name: --scope
options.description: Limit the migration to specific database schemas (namespaces). May be specified multiple times.

options.name: --destructive-actions
options.description: Policy for destructive actions: Error (default), Warn, or Allow.

commands.name: apply
commands.description: Compute the plan and apply it to the target database.

options.name: --config
options.description: Path to the NSchema config file. Defaults to ./nschema.json if present.

options.name: --provider
options.description: Database provider supplying the live schema (e.g. postgres).

options.name: --connection-string
options.description: Connection string for the database provider.

options.name: --state-file
options.description: Path for a file state store.

options.name: --state-s3-bucket
options.description: Bucket for an S3 state store.

options.name: --state-s3-key
options.description: Object key for an S3 state store.

options.name: --format
options.description: The format the desired schema is expressed in: yaml (default) or json.

options.name: --schema-dir
options.description: Directory containing the desired-schema files. Required for plan and apply unless set in config.

options.name: --schema-pattern
options.description: Glob matched within the schema directory. Defaults to a per-format pattern (e.g. **/*.yaml).

options.name: --scope
options.description: Limit the migration to specific database schemas (namespaces). May be specified multiple times.

options.name: --destructive-actions
options.description: Policy for destructive actions: Error (default), Warn, or Allow.

options.name: --auto-approve
options.description: Skip the interactive confirmation prompt and apply the plan immediately. [default: False]
